**CMOM**
- 
It is designed for young learners ages 0–6.

- 
Its current hours are Tuesday–Sunday, 10 am–5 pm.

- 
Its daily programming includes a 10:30 am Circle Time.

- The museum's pages disagree about Monday, Sept 14. 
Its FAQ says July–September is Monday–Sunday.
 
The visit page says daily hours run through Labor Day, September 7.
 I listed only Saturday, Sunday and Tuesday, so call them before planning around Monday.
- Its site showed no price, so I left it out.

**Brooklyn Children's Museum**
- 
The page says it offers three floors of interactive exhibits for ages 6 months to 10 years.

- 
It lists Wednesday–Sunday 10 am–5 pm, with Monday and Tuesday closed.
 Only the Saturday and Sunday of the trip work.
- The copy of the page I read looks like it was captured a while ago, so check the hours before going.
- I found no price on the museum's own site, so I left it out.
